item.title: About
item.description:
The BookCellar opens in Spring 2026 at 100 Stokes Croft, in the heart of Bristol’s most characterful neighbourhood. We’re an independent bookshop and reading room, a place built around the simple pleasure of a good book and a good glass.

The idea came from wanting somewhere that doesn’t quite exist yet. A third place, not home and not work, where you can arrive alone with a novel and feel completely at ease, or settle in with an old friend and let the conversation go wherever it goes. Somewhere to spend a quiet afternoon or a relaxed evening, shaped by stories and a calm atmosphere.

item.title: Book and Wine Pairings
item.description:
There is nothing better than sitting down with a great story and a drink that matches the mood, pace, or location. More than just words, a paired wine can transport the reader’s other senses into the narrative.

At the BookCellar, we believe that books and wine belong together. Both reward attention. And both, at their best, invite you to slow down. Our pairings are built on the simple idea that the right glass can deepen a story, and the right story can change how a wine is felt and remembered.

item.title: Careers
item.description: Thank you to everyone who applied for a role at the BookCellar. We are no longer accepting applications ahead of our opening in May 2026, but we very much look forward to welcoming you to the shop for a browse and a glass when we open.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Last updated: March 2026

This privacy policy explains how BookCellar Bristol Limited (trading as the BookCellar) collects and uses your personal data. We are based at 100 Stokes Croft, Bristol, and are the data controller for the purposes of UK GDPR.

What data we collect

When you sign up to our mailing list, we collect your email address. When you visit our website, we collect anonymised usage data via Google Analytics 4, including pages visited, time on site, and general location. We do not collect any data that identifies you personally through analytics.
